capabilities: Link the current note into a future daily note under a chosen heading
Parse plain-English dates with live suggestions showing the resolved date
Run quick commands for tomorrow, next week and next month without prompting
List notes scheduled for review in today's and later daily notes
Attach selected text as a block quote under the review link
extras: States that Review's block and heading variants are not implemented yet, and that the plugin makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: It is a tickler file for your vault, and a successor to Review
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to resurface a note on a future date inside your daily notes without a task manager or an extra date-parsing dependency.

relations.evidence: a successor to Review that does not need another plugin to read dates

summary: Tickler plugin that links the current note into a future daily note under a chosen heading, using a plain-English date you type.
